state_semantics.source_supported: the upstream mirror explicitly attests that the office endpoint was checked in the interval
state_semantics.source_unsupported: the upstream mirror explicitly attests that no supported endpoint was available in the interval
state_semantics.unattestable: the upstream mirror provides no per-office endpoint-check evidence for the interval

provenance.basis: congress-press monthly records do not publish a per-office endpoint-check registry
